funding.raw: Enabled native instance services do not come back after their owner host reboots. They stay `unavailable` with reason `cancelled` until someone disables and re-enables them.

admission.agent_reason: OWNER-authored production outage (enabled instance services do not recover after owner host reboot; pinned `cancelled`). Bounded single-defect change in packages/server/src/job-service.ts: add the host-shutdown `cancelled` reason to `readmittableCancellations` so `ensureInstanceService` readmits enabled services. Manifold is an active TypeScript repo that merges work (merged PRs present). No open PR references #1084. Unpriced founder wound: payer=atyrode, source_url=issue html_url.
admission.scope_quote: `readmittableCancellations` covers `requested`, `plugin_held`, `installation_changed`, `plugin_disabled`, `owner_fenced` and `owner_restart_effects_unknown`, but not the `cancelled` result
